bundle.shortDescription: Marklee — portable annotations for PDF, Markdown, and DOCX with edit-tolerant anchors and a lineage graph
bundle.longDescription: Marklee captures text and image snippets from PDF, Markdown, and Word documents. Annotations live in plain-JSON sidecars next to the source — no server, no account. Includes a directed lineage graph between snippets, a per-workspace group system, and the MarkRank centrality algorithm for surfacing the most-referenced ideas in a corpus.
